## Homework Due 10/29/26 7p

For the assignment below, you'll make a couple of models and assess them. Be sure to tell me what file I am supposed to look at and how I am to run the code. Hint: don't store the data on github.

### All students:

1.  \[30 points\] Run one of the four BDB submissions that we looked at in class on 10/14 on *hpc-student.charlotte.edu* and give evidence that you ran it via output, screenshots, etc. Data from the 2025 and 2026 Big Data Bowls can be found on *hpc-student.charlotte.edu* in the */projects/class/spoa4001_u01* folder. Note that you can access the github repositories for the submissions to get the relevant code but you'll likely have to move some files to the hpc.

Here are the four submissions:

[Attention is all you Need](https://github.com/SumerSports/SportsTrackingTransformer)

[2026 Winner](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/nfl-big-data-bowl-2026-analytics/writeups/ghostbusters-back-off-man-im-a-data-scientist)

[2026 Finalist](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/nfl-big-data-bowl-2026-analytics/writeups/new-writeup-1765813974702)

[2025 Competition](https://www.kaggle.com/code/sarahpollack/under-cover-2-predicting-disguised-defenses)

2.  \[15 points\] Tweak one of the parameters in the model that you run in Question 1 and rerun the analysis. Clearly explain the parameter that you changed and explain how the results have changed.

### ITCS 5010 Students:

3.  \[20 points on different assignment\] Choose a topic and a date for your presentation. The presentation should be 15 to 20 minutes on some topic in football analytics that we have not covered in class. For 10/29 you just need to pick a topic and a date.
